description: This PHP source file defines the 'License' Data Transfer Object (DTO) class within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. The class is used to retrieve and normalize license-related information for an employee, serving as part of the reporting display fields in the system.

classes.name: License
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class that encapsulates license information for an employee, providing methods to convert data into an array format suitable for reporting and normalization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the License DTO with the employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the license data of the referenced employee into an array based on specified fields.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Returns a map of field names to getter method chains used for extracting specific license attributes.
